result.title: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
result.comment: 35 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables; Project Page at https://iris0329.github.io/georeader-homepage/ GitHub Repo at https://github.com/iris0329/GeoReader
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

AI.brief_summary: GeoReader 训练轻量 Geometric Reader 将 RGB 预测的几何结构转成 VLM 可直接读取的连续输入 token，以冻结 VLM 解码的几何描述作训练监督，再冻结 Reader、按问题条件注入几何来微调 VLM 做空间问答，推理时不再生成几何链式思考。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及「视觉几何信息是否被内部状态保留并被答案使用」：文中报告把已对齐 latent 置零后精度不变，指向 latent 内容未被利用的信息坍缩问题，可供核查几何证据筛选与 latent 贡献分配的具体做法。
